'''Whimper Save''' was a mysterious [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] inside the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] with the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] while the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] visited. During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] shortly afterwards, she was talking with Faytonni at the bar of the Outlander when Wesell entered the club, trying to [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|escape]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. She turned to stare when Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] was [[Dismemberment/Legends|cut off]] by Kenobi.

==Biography==
Whimper Save was a mysterious<ref name="Insider" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]].<ref name="DB" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC Note">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. The scene from ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'' in which [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] is in the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] takes place shortly before the film's [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].</ref> she<ref name="Insider" /> was on<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], visiting the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of Coruscant.<ref name="CSWE2" /> She was in the company of<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]]<ref name="DB2">{{DB|character|lieutenantfaytonni|Faytonni, Lieutenant Dannl}}</ref> and<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /> the anarchist criminal [[Reina March]].<ref name="DB3">{{DB|character|reinamarch|March, Reina}}</ref> The group was at the club the same time as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]], who were there planning an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" />

[[File:FaytonniReinaWhimper-AOTC.png|thumb|left|300px|Save, Faytonni, and March turned to stare at Wesell.]]
One [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AoTC" /> shortly afterwards,<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Save was once again in the Outlander Club with Faytonni and March,<ref name="AoTC" /> drinking at the bar<ref name="IA">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2002/11/imageattack20021126.html|series=Image Attack|text=Good Save}}</ref> and talking with Faytonni. During their visit, Wesell ran inside the club to escape the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after failing to assassinate Amidala.<ref name="AoTC" /> When Kenobi made his way to the bar, a Human patron joined the trio and talked with March, drawing the attention of Save. When the Human departed, Save turned her focus back to Faytonni, with whom she was now holding hands with.<ref name="AoTC" />

A short while later, Wesell's [[Limb/Legends|arm]] was [[Dismemberment/Legends|cut off]] by Kenobi in an unsuccessful ambush, drawing the attention of Save and her companions. As Wesell was being helped up by the Jedi, a smiling Save began talking with Faytonni again. Skywalker then told the clubgoers to go back to their drinks and left with Kenobi to interrogate the bounty hunter outside.<ref name="AoTC" /> While that took place, Faytonni left Save to walk with his [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] partner [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==Personality and traits==
Save was an enigmatic<ref name="DB" /> and mysterious individual who was considered beautiful.<ref name="Insider" /> She had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin, dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="DB" /> It was unclear whether or not she was an associate of Faytonni or if she was taken in by his [[Republic Security Force/Legends|security officer]] ruse,<ref name="Insider" /> which could draw in some of the more desperate Human women at the Outlander.<ref name="FF96">{{FactFile|96|OUT 1-2|Outlander Nightclub Patrons}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Unlike other Outlander Club patrons,<ref name="Insider" /> Save wore a dark,<ref name="AoTC" /> hooded [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]]<ref name="Insider" /> during her visits to the club.<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter" /><ref name="AoTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The votes are in for the “Best Name in Episode II" awards, with Whimper Save edging out Jedi Knight Bultar Swan to win top honors in the so-unofficial-we-just-made-it-up competition.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Insider" />}}
[[File:Faytonni_ep2dvd.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The uncredited extra playing Save on set, with [[Anthony Daniels]]]]
Whimper Save was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="AoTC" /> which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> The Outlander Club scenes, where Save was portrayed by an uncredited extra, were shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, Save was first pictured in the documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Save then first appeared in illustrations for both the film's [[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook|storybook]], written by [[Jane Mason]] and [[Sarah Hines Stephens]],<ref name="Storybook">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Movie Storybook]]''</ref> and the young readers book ''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]'', written by [[Eric Arnold]] and illustrated by [[Valerie Reckert]].<ref name="Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter">''[[Jango Fett: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Both books were published on [[April 23]], 2002.<ref name="Amazon">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/young/news20020225.html|text=Book Preview: Episode II Children's Books}}</ref>

Whimper Save was first identified though the [[Image Attack]] feature on [[StarWars.com]] on [[November 26]], 2002.<ref name="IA" /> In the [[May 2]], [[2003]], [[StarWars.com]] web article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]," Save is incorrectly identified as a different Outlander Club patron.<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> In the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]," published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] pokes fun at Save's name, writing that the character beat out [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and won the "so-unofficial-we-just-made-it-up competition" at the "Best Name in Episode II" awards.<ref name="Insider" />
